description: This file is a standalone PHP script used for upgrading a SuiteCRM instance silently from the command line. It includes setup, validation, and execution of the upgrade process, including database repair, cache clearing, relationship rebuilding, and logging.

classes.name: RepairAndClear
classes.description: A class responsible for database repair and cache clearing operations within the upgrade process.

methods.name: checkConfigForPermissions
methods.description: Checks and adds default permissions to the config.php if missing.

methods.name: checkLoggerSettings
methods.description: Ensures logger settings are configured in config.php.

methods.name: checkResourceSettings
methods.description: Ensures resource management settings are configured in config.php.

methods.name: verifyArguments
methods.description: Validates command-line arguments for the upgrade script.
